title: BLAI Research Brief v1
description: A SOURCED research brief that educates the storyboard stage. Written by blai-research from web sources; read by blai-storyboard as ground truth. Every claim cites a page actually fetched this session; anything unverified goes in `unverified`, never `claims`. `explanation_path` + `suggested_outline` are the cohesion mechanism — the storyboard follows the route from zero to the payoff instead of assembling beats blind.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp the brief was written

depth.description: standard = built-in WebSearch/WebFetch; deep = also Firecrawl MCP full-page extraction

thesis.description: One sentence: the single idea this video lands

explanation_path.description: Prose: the recommended route from zero to the payoff — what must be understood before what. This is what makes the short cohesive instead of disjointed.

claims.description: Load-bearing facts. A URL may appear here ONLY if a page was actually fetched this session.

accessed.description: ISO date the page was fetched

key_numbers.description: Numbers the narration may cite, normalized to comparable units. The storyboard checks its numbers against these.

analogy_candidates.description: Candidate analogies for the storyboard to choose from — each with its breaking point named

misconceptions.description: Counterintuitive facts / common myths — hook fuel and accuracy guards

glossary.description: Terms the video must define in ≤1 sentence

unverified.description: Claims that could NOT be grounded in a fetched source. The storyboard may use these only hedged, or not at all.

suggested_outline.description: Newline-separated beats, one per line — seeds input.outline when it's empty

notes.description: Anything else the storyboard writer should know (open questions, conflicting sources)
